common.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything. Short.

common.save.description: Button in the rename dialog that keeps the new device name. Short.

common.done.description: Button that closes the “Add a device” dialog once the other device has the link. Short.

common.dismiss.description: Button on a warning card that hides it. Short.

common.rename.description: Button on a device row that opens the rename dialog. Short.

common.remove.description: Button on a device row, and the confirming button in the remove dialog, that takes the device out of the group. Short.

common.copyLink.description: Small button that copies a web address to the clipboard: on a history entry, and in the “Add a device” dialog. Short.

common.copied.description: Replaces “Copy link” for a moment after the address was copied. Short.
